name: Fund Parameters 5
definition: Parameters required to request a fund reference data report.

FinancialInstrumentDetails.name: Financial Instrument Details
FinancialInstrumentDetails.definition: Financial instrument for which the report is requested.

FundManagementCompany.name: Fund Management Company
FundManagementCompany.definition: Fund management company for which the report is requested.

DateFrom.name: Date From
DateFrom.definition: Specifies the date on or after which the information required will have been last updated. Only the most recent versions of the data is required.

CountryOfDomicile.name: Country Of Domicile
CountryOfDomicile.definition: Country where the fund has legal domicile.

RegisteredDistributionCountry.name: Registered Distribution Country
RegisteredDistributionCountry.definition: Country where the fund is registered for distribution.
